positions.name: AsyncJobDispatchPollContract
positions.frame: what is the dispatch-then-poll contract for remember's async job — receipt, polling, and no-blocking guarantees?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same ratified mechanics from a single directional read: remember dispatches and returns immediately (a receipt in seconds / dispatch-then-poll), the actual extraction work is tracked asynchronously (polling a cursor / polling the run or piggybacked reaction), and no blocking call is made. src-1 states the ratification directly with its guarantee (no lost work if the receipt is dropped); src-2 restates the decision in a slightly different vocabulary (poll vs. piggyback on a later call). Read together they describe one contract shape rather than two competing ones — the tension is only in phrasing, not in substance.
